primary.poolable_reason: WITHDRAWN 2026-08-18. THE FOUR TRIALS DO NOT MEASURE THE SAME THING, AND ONE OF THEM DOES NOT MEASURE AN EVENT AT ALL. Registered primaries read from ClinicalTrials.gov on 2026-08-18: FIDELIO-DKD (NCT02540993) a KIDNEY-FAILURE composite; FIGARO-DKD (NCT02545049) a composite of cardiovascular death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, non-fatal stroke and heart-failure hospitalisation; FINEARTS-HF (NCT04435626) cardiovascular death and total heart-failure events; ARTS-DN (NCT01874431) 'RATIO OF UACR AT DAY 90 TO UACR AT BASELINE'. THREE DIFFERENT EVENT COMPOSITES AND A CONTINUOUS ALBUMINURIA RATIO were pooled as a single odds ratio. ARTS-DN's 0.385 is not an odds ratio; it is a ratio of a continuous biomarker, and it entered a pool of event risks. NO HARMONISED OUTCOME EXISTS at any rank -- checked before withdrawing, per the SGLT2 lesson -- because ARTS-DN is a phase 2b biomarker trial with no cardiovascular outcome data. There is no replacement pool and that is the honest position.

primary.the_nulled_prefix_was_not_honoured: The fourth row is `trial_id: 'NULLED:NCT01874431'`. RE-DERIVED: k=4 INCLUDING IT GIVES 0.8470425219, WHICH MATCHES THE PUBLISHED VALUE TO TEN DECIMAL PLACES; dropping it gives 0.8478182774. The prefix was intended to exclude the trial and THE POOLING STEP IGNORED IT. A MARKER THAT THE CONSUMER DOES NOT READ IS NOT AN EXCLUSION -- the same law as a field the consumer cannot find and a shape it cannot read.
primary.found_by: Found by an EXTERNAL VALIDATOR -- rct-extractor-v2's outcome-grouping guard, written independently by people who hit these defect classes separately. Verified here against every registration before acting. FOURTH INSTANCE THIS WEEK of an outside check finding what our own passes missed, after Codex on ARNI's internal contradiction, Gemini on the SGLT2 disproportion, and a blinded comparator on the PARACHUTE-HF adverse-event discrepancy.
primary.what_this_does_not_establish: NOT that finerenone is ineffective, and NOT that any of these trials is poor -- each reports its own registered primary correctly. NOT that no finerenone synthesis is possible: FIDELIO-DKD and FIGARO-DKD share enough structure that a pooled analysis of them exists in the literature. ONLY that THIS pool combined quantities that are not the same quantity.
primary.k_corrected_2026_08_18: k was 4 and only THREE rows are unmarked. The fourth carries trial_id NULLED:NCT01874431 and was counted anyway -- the published 0.8470425219 re-derives EXACTLY with it in and NOT without it. k now counts the rows that may contribute. The marked row is KEPT, because an exclusion record is evidence; what does not survive is its CONTRIBUTION. This topic is withdrawn regardless, on the separate and sufficient ground that its trials measure incommensurable constructs.
primary.poolable_DEPRECATED_note: `poolable` MEANT ONLY 'the source page pooled these trials'. It was never a judgement that the pool was sound, and the renderer read it as permission to assert 'pooled on the X scale'. RENAMED to source_page_pooled, which is what it says. `poolable` is retained so nothing breaks, and it is DEPRECATED: read source_page_pooled for what the source did, and estimand_established for whether the pool is defensible. A PAGE SHOULD DISPLAY A POOLED ESTIMATE BECAUSE ITS ESTIMAND WAS ESTABLISHED, NOT BECAUSE SOMEONE ONCE POOLED IT.
primary.estimand_established_means: TRUE only where every contributing trial has been READ and shown to measure the same quantity, or the same construct with a variance stated. FALSE where that was checked and failed. NULL where it was never checked -- AN ABSENT ASSERTION AND A NEGATIVE ONE ARE DIFFERENT STATES and null is not a pass.
primary.estimand_established_does_not_cover_the_: READ THIS BESIDE `estimand_established`. That flag records that every contributing trial measures the SAME QUANTITY. It records NOTHING about what that quantity was measured AGAINST -- whether the comparators are of one kind, whether each comparison was randomised, whether it was concurrent. On attr-pn-review the flag is TRUE and correct while the pool combines patisiran against its own saline placebo, vutrisiran against PATISIRAN, and eplontersen against the placebo cohort of a DIFFERENT TRIAL. The two questions were never separated. Named as P48 in PAGE-STANDARD.md v1.21.0 and swept by scripts/audit_mixed_contrast_pools.py.

manuscript.introduction:
This review asks: In adults with heart failure, does Finerenone (BAY94-8862) compared with placebo affect the outcome each trial registered as its primary, which differ across the 3 trials here?

It examines 3 randomised trials and DOES NOT POOL THEM, against not recorded on the page this object was extracted from.

The outcome sought is Multiple trial-declared outcomes: The First Occurrence of the Composite Endpoint of Onset of Kidney Failure, a Sustained Decrease of eGFR ≥40% From Baseli | The First Occurrence of the Composite Endpoint of Cardiovascular Death, Non-fatal Myocardial Infarction, Non Fatal Strok | Occurrence of the Composite Endpoint of Cardiovascular Death and Total (First and Recurrent) Heart Failure Events | Ratio of UACR at Day 90 to UACR at Baseline.
